research_attempts.query_text: NARA OSS index pages 89-90 and complete Army exact-name comparison; Marguerite Connelly exact-name OSS/CIA, Catalog, employer, occupation, obituary, directory, newspaper, current Library of Congress and archival checks.
research_attempts.rejection_reasons: Exact-name web results concern multiple later generations or people whose surname was acquired through marriage. None supplies an OSS, identifier or Box 139 bridge.
research_attempts.research_notes: No reliable pre-OSS employer has yet been identified in the accessible sources reviewed. This is not evidence that no employer existed.
research_attempts.next_action: Establish identity and pre-OSS chronology in Box 139.
